description: Paralog verdict table combining LDS pocket identity with substantia nigra expression
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
PARAS=["MAP1LC3A","MAP1LC3B","MAP1LC3C","GABARAP","GABARAPL1","GABARAPL2"]
T=pd.read_csv("LDS_residue_comparison.csv"); R=pd.read_csv("LIR_position_contact_conservation.csv")
G=pd.read_csv("GTEx_ATG8_brain.csv", index_col=0)
sn=G["Brain_Substantia_nigra"]

# core-reading LDS positions = those contacting Theta-1, Theta(0), X1, X2
core_pos=set()
for _,r in R.iterrows():
    if r.pep_position in ["Theta-1","Theta(0)","X1","X2"]:
        for tok in str(r.contact_residues_LC3Bnum).split("; "):
            core_pos.add(int(tok.strip("*")[1:]))
flank_pos=set()
for _,r in R.iterrows():
    if r.pep_position in ["Gamma(+3)","+4","+5"]:
        for tok in str(r.contact_residues_LC3Bnum).split("; "):
            flank_pos.add(int(tok.strip("*")[1:]))
sub=T[T.LC3B_pos.isin(core_pos)]
rows=[]
for p in PARAS:
    ident_core=np.mean([1 if sub.loc[i,p]!="-" and sub.loc[i,p][0]==sub.loc[i,"MAP1LC3B"][0] else 0 for i in sub.index])
    sub2=T[T.LC3B_pos.isin(flank_pos)]
    ident_fl=np.mean([1 if sub2.loc[i,p]!="-" and sub2.loc[i,p][0]==sub2.loc[i,"MAP1LC3B"][0] else 0 for i in sub2.index])
    rows.append(dict(paralog=p,
        core_reading_LDS_identity_to_LC3B=round(100*ident_core,1),
        flank_reading_LDS_identity_to_LC3B=round(100*ident_fl,1),
        SN_median_TPM=round(float(sn[p]),2),
        pocket_compatible_with_YTPL="yes (all core-reading residues identical)",
        verdict=("excluded on expression (0.16 TPM, 1542-fold below GABARAP)" if p=="MAP1LC3C"
                 else "plausible endogenous partner")))
V=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("SN_median_TPM",ascending=False)
V.to_csv("paralog_verdict_table.csv",index=False)
print(V.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2,5))
x=V.core_reading_LDS_identity_to_LC3B.values; y=V.SN_median_TPM.values
ax.scatter(x,y,s=140,c=["#c53030" if p=="MAP1LC3C" else "#2b6cb0" for p in V.paralog],zorder=3)
for xi,yi,p in zip(x,y,V.paralog):
    ax.annotate(p,(xi,yi),xytext=(6,6),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=9)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylim(0.08,600)
ax.set_xlim(85,103)
ax.axhline(1,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1); ax.text(85.3,1.15,"1 TPM",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("identity to LC3B at the LDS residues that read the LIR core\n(Theta-1, Theta, X1, X2 contacts), %")
ax.set_ylabel("GTEx median TPM, substantia nigra (log)")
ax.set_title("Paralog triage for LMX1B: the pocket cannot discriminate, expression can\n"
             "all six are pocket-identical where it matters; only MAP1LC3C is absent from midbrain tissue", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
